rows.doc: A find from the tile's spoils pool where battles were fought in the window; magnitude is the most it takes.
Your own lost haul, found where you went down, if it is still in the pool.
Someone who knows what you carry greets you differently: standing on a first meeting while you hold an item of their trade.
The species that has downed you most gets a line, and you a slightly better opening against it.
Under this share of the tile's capacity, an encounter is this likely not to happen.
Elevation this far above the tile you came from: ranged and reach options one band better.
A river or stream under drought is crossed at this cost.
Tracks this recent on the tile give an option to follow whoever passed.
Someone who heard a cache's rumour may search for it.
A node gathered past its stock tags worked-out until it recovers.
The share of Uncommon spoils that come as a locked pouch, for a character who has worked a machine; the pouch holds the same goods.
A party of two, either of whom rescued the other: holding is this much better.
A key held for this dungeon opens the third way, and this many are used up.
